author: Zephyr I
title: Late time injection to POLICY head only — std-width nodil (BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Isolate where time helps: append time only to the policy head (not value). Std-width CNN (32/64), d=5 on main convs, undilated bottlenecks, double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64), single-head AttnPool, AdamW+clip. BASE_SEED=42.
